summary: Denver-based ultra-low-cost airline: the fare covers your seat and one personal item, everything else is extra.
checkin: Check-in opens 24 hours before departure. Check-in and bag drop close 1 hour before departure; ticket counters usually open 2 hours before.
baggage: Free personal item up to 8 x 18 x 14 in. A carry-on (up to 10 x 16 x 24 in, 35 lb) and checked bags cost extra, alone or in a bundle. Prices vary by date and are higher at check-in and at the airport.
tips: Buy bags when you book; they cost more later.
Bags from 41 to 50 lb are charged as overweight.
